experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Experience the iconic Magic Kingdom with classic rides like Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy parade and end the night with the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore 11 country pavilions around World Showcase Lagoon, sampling authentic cuisines from Mexico, Japan, France, Morocco, and more. Enjoy live cultural performances, artisan demonstrations, and the stunning EPCOT Forever nighttime spectacular over the lagoon.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Batuu. Build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, and experience the thrilling Rise of the Resistance ride. Dine at the Oga's Cantina for themed drinks and snacks.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day
experiences.description: Spend a budget-friendly day at Disney Springs exploring free entertainment, street performers, and unique dining. Visit the LEGO Store, enjoy a meal at T-REX Cafe, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24, and browse over 100 shops and restaurants with no park admission required.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Start your morning with a Kilimanjaro Safari to spot lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos in a realistic savanna setting. Then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage ride. Explore the Pandora World of Avatar at dusk when the bioluminescent landscape glows beautifully.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora & Africa Sections, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando
